budget_items.topic: Eagle House ADA-compliant ramp construction cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW Director's email reported the Eagle House ramp cost rising after conferring with David Ross Associates.
budget_items.quote: increasing the cost of eagle house ada-compliant ramp construction from $25,000.00 to $40,000.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A similar cost issue on the Townsend Hbr/Mulpus Rd project (FY 2014 Capital Plan) was noted, with no contingency in place.
budget_items.quote: he also noted there is a similar issue with the townsend hbr/mulpus rd project (fy 2014 capital plan) and there should have been a contingency plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said the $500,000 annual amount is always there, is too low going forward, and should be increased.
budget_items.quote: there is nothing new at the present time other than the $500,000 which is always there.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said $107,000 was budgeted for additional road work and she hopes to increase it.
budget_items.quote: $107,000 had been put in the budget for additional road work and she hopes to be able to increase that amount

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager suggested putting in the figures the Director of Building and Grounds had for 2016 going forward, with a footnote, but no dollar amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: the director of building and grounds had in 2016 going forward so it's reflected; with a footnote subject to change.
